observation.command:
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 -c '
found=""
for j in /opt/keycloak/lib/main/quarkus/lib/*.jar; do
  if unzip -p "$j" org/keycloak/themes/keycloak/base/messages/messages.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -q "invalidPasswordMinSpecialCharsMessage"; then
    found="$j"; break
  fi
done
echo "FOUND: $found"
unzip -p "$found" org/keycloak/themes/keycloak/base/messages/messages.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -i "specialchar" 
unzip -p "$found" org/keycloak/themes/keycloak/base/messages/messages.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "^invalidPassword|length" | head -20
' 2>&1
